title: 有名俳優に似た人物がt2vで出てしまう場合は、人物の「キャラクターシート」を作って参照させ、顔・髪型・体型を具体的に固定する
content:
有名俳優に似た人物がt2vで出てしまう場合は、人物の「キャラクターシート」を作って参照させ、顔・髪型・体型を具体的に固定する  
ビールCMの生成では「キャラクターシート（登場人物の画像）」と「プロダクトシート（ビールの画像）」の2種類を参照画像として使い分けて一貫性を出す  
t2vで意図しない人物像になったら、参照画像を使えるi2vに切り替えて生成をコントロールする  
キャラクターシートは「フラットなミッドグレー背景＋正面均一ライティング＋3ビュー（顔正面のバストアップ／首下のみの正面全身／背面全身）」の構成で作る  
キャラクターシートのプロンプトでは「映画的効果（フィルムグレイン、レンズ効果、ビネット、カラーグレード、DOF）を入れない」「ラベルや注釈など余計な要素を入れない」を明示して参照画像の純度を上げる

en.content:
If a person resembling a famous actor appears in t2v, create a “character sheet” for that person and have the model reference it, explicitly fixing the face, hairstyle, and body type.

For beer CM generation, use two different types of reference images to create consistency: a “character sheet” (images of the characters) and a “product sheet” (images of the beer).

If t2v produces an unintended character likeness, switch to i2v, where reference images can be used, to control the generation.

Create the character sheet with the following structure: “flat mid-gray background + uniform frontal lighting + 3 views (front-facing bust shot / front full body from the neck down only / back full body)”.

In the character sheet prompt, explicitly state: “do not include cinematic effects (film grain, lens effects, vignette, color grading, DOF)” and “do not include unnecessary elements such as labels or annotations” to improve the purity of the reference image.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
When using Seedance 2.5 t2v (text-to-video) to create a “Japanese man in his 40s,” there’s a strange issue where he ends up looking like a famous actor 🤔

Specifically, it can generate a man who resembles Hiroshi Abe or Hidetoshi Nishijima.

I finally encountered this phenomenon myself 😂
If you look closely, he is a different person, but at first glance he looks like a “lookalike.”

What I recommend in cases like this is creating a “character sheet” and using it as a reference.

Instead of letting the AI imagine the character on its own,
you specify in advance:
“This is the face, hairstyle, and body type.”

Here is the prompt I used to create the character sheet ↓
If you run into a similar issue, feel free to customize and use it 😃

---------------------------
A single character reference sheet photograph, wide landscape format, on one continuous
plain flat mid-grey background, perfectly uniform with no gradient and no shadow falling
on it. Flat even studio lighting from the front across the whole sheet, no dramatic
light, no rim light, no colour cast.

Three views of the same person are arranged side by side on this one sheet, evenly
spaced, all standing on the same invisible ground line, all lit identically.

THE SUBJECT — an adult Japanese man with the worn look of someone well into working life,
lean and wiry, with a long narrow face and a visible jaw hinge. Warm-toned skin, tanned
and weathered by sun, with sun lines at the outer corners of the eyes. Narrow hooded eyes,
a straight even nose bridge, thin lips, an angular jaw. His gaze is level and unhurried,
calm and settled. Short black hair cropped close at the sides, a few grey threads at the
temples, pushed back off the forehead. Light patchy stubble across the jaw and upper lip,
a few days old.
He wears a faded olive-green cotton jungle shirt, softened and thinned by wear, sleeves
rolled to just below the elbow, with the top button undone so the collar sits open and
loose at the throat; dark khaki cargo trousers with flat side pockets; and scuffed brown
leather hiking boots.
He wears no harness of any kind: no waist belt, no buckle, no thigh loops, no webbing
straps, no rope, no carabiner, nothing strapped over his clothing anywhere on his body.
His nose stays exactly the same colour as the rest of his face: no red tint, no pink tint,
no rosy tip. His skin is dry and matte: no sweat, no oily sheen, no wet highlights.

LEFT VIEW — a large portrait, head and shoulders only. The face is square to the camera
and looks straight into the lens — the face is frontal, not turned away. The head is
tilted gently to one side: the crown of the head tips toward the subject's own right
shoulder, which is the shoulder on the FRAME-LEFT side of the picture. A soft tilt of
roughly ten degrees, no more. The shoulders stay level. This tilt is required.
This portrait is by far the largest element on the sheet: the head alone is at least
twice the height of either standing figure's head, and it fills roughly the left third
of the picture from top to bottom.
Keep the real fine pores, vellus hair, stubble texture and natural asymmetry of the skin.
No retouching, no smoothing, no beauty filter. A small clear catch-light in each eye.

CENTRE VIEW — a full-body figure from the neck down, standing straight and facing the
camera, arms relaxed at the sides, feet slightly apart. The figure ends cleanly at the
base of the neck: no head, no chin, no face is drawn anywhere on this figure.
Show the lean build, the narrow shoulders, the roll of the sleeves, the open collar at the
base of the neck, the cut and length of the shirt, the cargo pockets and the boots clearly
and unobstructed.

RIGHT VIEW — the same figure seen from directly behind, full body including the head this
time, standing straight, arms relaxed at the sides. Show the short black hair at the back
of the head and the bare neckline, the back yoke and hem of the olive shirt with nothing
strapped across it, the rear pockets of the cargo trousers, and the heels of the boots.

Photorealistic throughout. Keep the fabric weave real.
No film grain, no cinematic lens effects, no vignette, no colour grade, no depth-of-field
blur.

Nothing else is on the sheet: no labels, no captions, no names, no arrows, no measurement
lines, no borders, no colour swatches, no props, no second person, no harness, no rope.
Only the three views and the flat grey background.

quality: high
aspect ratio: 3:2

Si en t2v el personaje resultante no es el deseado, cambia a i2v, donde puedes usar imágenes de referencia, para controlar la generación.  
La character sheet debe crearse con esta estructura: “fondo gris medio plano + iluminación frontal uniforme + 3 vistas (busto frontal del rostro / cuerpo completo frontal sin cabeza, solo desde el cuello hacia abajo / cuerpo completo de espaldas)”.  
En el prompt de la character sheet, deja explícito que no se deben incluir “efectos cinematográficos (film grain, lens effects, vignette, color grade, DOF)” ni “elementos innecesarios como etiquetas o anotaciones”, para aumentar la pureza de la imagen de referencia.

Yo también me topé por fin con este fenómeno 😂  
Si miras con atención, es otra persona, pero a primera vista parece un “doble” muy parecido.

Cuando pasa esto, lo recomendable es crear una “character sheet” y hacer que el modelo la tome como referencia.

En lugar de dejar que la IA imagine libremente la apariencia del personaje,  
le indicas de antemano de forma concreta:  
“Esta persona tiene este rostro, este peinado y este tipo de cuerpo”.

Aquí está el prompt que usé para la character sheet ↓  
Si te encuentras con un fenómeno parecido, personalízalo y úsalo sin problema 😃

Dans le prompt de la character sheet, précisez clairement : « ne pas inclure d’effets cinématographiques (film grain, lens effects, vignette, color grade, DOF) » et « ne pas inclure d’éléments superflus comme des labels ou des annotations », afin d’améliorer la pureté de l’image de référence.

ko.content:
유명 배우와 닮은 인물이 t2v에서 생성될 경우에는, 인물의 “캐릭터 시트”를 만들어 참조하게 하고, 얼굴·헤어스타일·체형을 구체적으로 고정한다  
맥주 CM 생성에서는 “캐릭터 시트(등장인물 이미지)”와 “프로덕트 시트(맥주 이미지)”의 2종류를 참조 이미지로 구분해 사용해 일관성을 높인다  
t2v에서 의도하지 않은 인물상이 나오면, 참조 이미지를 사용할 수 있는 i2v로 전환해 생성을 제어한다  
캐릭터 시트는 “플랫한 미드그레이 배경 + 정면 균일 라이팅 + 3뷰(얼굴 정면 바스트업 / 목 아래만 보이는 정면 전신 / 후면 전신)” 구성으로 만든다  
캐릭터 시트 프롬프트에서는 “영화적 효과(필름 그레인, 렌즈 효과, 비네팅, 컬러 그레이드, DOF)를 넣지 않는다” “라벨이나 주석 등 불필요한 요소를 넣지 않는다”를 명시해 참조 이미지의 순도를 높인다

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
Seedance 2.5의 t2v(텍스트→비디오)로 “40대의 일본인 남성”을 만들면, 왜인지 유명 배우를 닮아버리는 문제🤔

구체적으로는, 아베 히로시 씨나 니시지마 히데토시 씨를 닮은 남성이 생성되는 경우가 있습니다.

저도 드디어 이 현상을 겪었습니다😂  
자세히 보면 다른 사람이지만, 얼핏 보면 “닮은꼴”처럼 보입니다.

이럴 때 추천하는 방법이 바로 “캐릭터 시트”를 만들어 참조시키는 것입니다.

AI가 인물상을 멋대로 상상하게 두는 것이 아니라,  
“이 얼굴·헤어스타일·체형의 인물입니다”  
라고 미리 구체적으로 지정해 두는 방식이죠.

제가 만든 캐릭터 시트용 프롬프트는 아래와 같습니다↓  
비슷한 현상을 겪게 되면 꼭 커스터마이즈해서 사용해 보세요😃

Se, no t2v, a figura humana sair diferente do que você pretendia, mude para i2v, que permite usar imagens de referência, e controle a geração  
A character sheet deve ser criada com a composição “fundo cinza-médio plano + iluminação frontal uniforme + 3 views (busto frontal do rosto / corpo inteiro frontal apenas do pescoço para baixo / corpo inteiro de costas)”  
No prompt da character sheet, deixe explícito que não deve incluir “efeitos cinematográficos (film grain, lens effects, vignette, color grade, DOF)” nem “elementos extras como rótulos e anotações”, para aumentar a pureza da imagem de referência

--- TWEET CITADO ---
Ao criar um “homem japonês na faixa dos 40 anos” no t2v (texto → vídeo) do Seedance 2.5, por algum motivo ele acaba ficando parecido com um ator famoso 🤔

Mais especificamente, às vezes são gerados homens parecidos com Hiroshi Abe ou Hidetoshi Nishijima.

Eu também finalmente me deparei com esse fenômeno 😂
Olhando com atenção, é outra pessoa, mas, à primeira vista, parece um “sósia”.

Nesses casos, o recomendado é criar uma “character sheet” e usá-la como referência.

Em vez de deixar a IA imaginar livremente a aparência da pessoa,
você especifica com antecedência:
“é uma pessoa com este rosto, este penteado e este tipo físico”.

O prompt que eu usei para a character sheet é este aqui ↓
Se você encontrar um fenômeno parecido, sinta-se à vontade para personalizar e usar 😃

---------------------------
A single character reference sheet photograph, wide landscape format, on one continuous
plain flat mid-grey background, perfectly uniform with no gradient and no shadow falling
on it. Flat even studio lighting from the front across the whole sheet, no dramatic
light, no rim light, no colour cast.

Three views of the same person are arranged side by side on this one sheet, evenly
spaced, all standing on the same invisible ground line, all lit identically.

THE SUBJECT — an adult Japanese man with the worn look of someone well into working life,
lean and wiry, with a long narrow face and a visible jaw hinge. Warm-toned skin, tanned
and weathered by sun, with sun lines at the outer corners of the eyes. Narrow hooded eyes,
a straight even nose bridge, thin lips, an angular jaw. His gaze is level and unhurried,
calm and settled. Short black hair cropped close at the sides, a few grey threads at the
temples, pushed back off the forehead. Light patchy stubble across the jaw and upper lip,
a few days old.
He wears a faded olive-green cotton jungle shirt, softened and thinned by wear, sleeves
rolled to just below the elbow, with the top button undone so the collar sits open and
loose at the throat; dark khaki cargo trousers with flat side pockets; and scuffed brown
leather hiking boots.
He wears no harness of any kind: no waist belt, no buckle, no thigh loops, no webbing
straps, no rope, no carabiner, nothing strapped over his clothing anywhere on his body.
His nose stays exactly the same colour as the rest of his face: no red tint, no pink tint,
no rosy tip. His skin is dry and matte: no sweat, no oily sheen, no wet highlights.

LEFT VIEW — a large portrait, head and shoulders only. The face is square to the camera
and looks straight into the lens — the face is frontal, not turned away. The head is
tilted gently to one side: the crown of the head tips toward the subject's own right
shoulder, which is the shoulder on the FRAME-LEFT side of the picture. A soft tilt of
roughly ten degrees, no more. The shoulders stay level. This tilt is required.
This portrait is by far the largest element on the sheet: the head alone is at least
twice the height of either standing figure's head, and it fills roughly the left third
of the picture from top to bottom.
Keep the real fine pores, vellus hair, stubble texture and natural asymmetry of the skin.
No retouching, no smoothing, no beauty filter. A small clear catch-light in each eye.

CENTRE VIEW — a full-body figure from the neck down, standing straight and facing the
camera, arms relaxed at the sides, feet slightly apart. The figure ends cleanly at the
base of the neck: no head, no chin, no face is drawn anywhere on this figure.
Show the lean build, the narrow shoulders, the roll of the sleeves, the open collar at the
base of the neck, the cut and length of the shirt, the cargo pockets and the boots clearly
and unobstructed.

RIGHT VIEW — the same figure seen from directly behind, full body including the head this
time, standing straight, arms relaxed at the sides. Show the short black hair at the back
of the head and the bare neckline, the back yoke and hem of the olive shirt with nothing
strapped across it, the rear pockets of the cargo trousers, and the heels of the boots.

Photorealistic throughout. Keep the fabric weave real.
No film grain, no cinematic lens effects, no vignette, no colour grade, no depth-of-field
blur.

Nothing else is on the sheet: no labels, no captions, no names, no arrows, no measurement
lines, no borders, no colour swatches, no props, no second person, no harness, no rope.
Only the three views and the flat grey background.

quality: high
aspect ratio: 3:2

如果在 t2v 中生成出类似知名演员的人物，就制作该人物的“角色设定表（character sheet）”并让模型参考，具体固定脸型、发型和体型  
在生成啤酒广告时，可以把“角色设定表（登场人物图片）”和“产品设定表（啤酒图片）”这两类参考图分开使用，以增强一致性  
如果 t2v 生成出了非预期的人物形象，就切换到可以使用参考图的 i2v 来控制生成  
角色设定表建议采用“纯平的中灰背景＋正面均匀打光＋三视图（正面脸部半身像／仅颈部以下的正面全身／背面全身）”的构成来制作  
在角色设定表的 prompt 中，要明确写出“不要加入电影感效果（film grain、镜头效果、vignette、color grade、DOF）”“不要加入标签、注释等多余元素”，以提高参考图的纯净度
